source.name: Sports Business Journal: 'Charlotte FC, Ally Financial weighing sponsorship extension'
source.quote: The bank pays an average of $8M for its Charlotte FC sponsorship, excluding additional investments in promotions, advertising and related programs.
source.note: Average annual figure reported by SBJ citing the Charlotte Business Journal; it covers Ally's whole Charlotte FC sponsorship, not the front-of-kit fee alone. The same article says the deal is within two years of expiring, so no end year is recorded.

note: Ally has been the front-of-kit sponsor on every kit in the club's history; the first primary kit, unveiled 2021-12-09 with Ally as lead front-of-jersey sponsor, was worn from the inaugural 2022 MLS season. Club announcements: 'Charlotte FC Officially Unveils Its First-Ever Primary Kit' (2021-12-09, https://www.charlottefootballclub.com/news/charlotte-fc-officially-unveils-its-first-ever-primary-kit — 'The “Carolina” kit is set to be worn by Charlotte FC’s players for the 2022 and 2023 MLS seasons') and 'Charlotte FC Reveals New Primary Kit Ahead of 2026 Season' (2026-02-10).
